title: You don't need a high IQ to trade
caption: Tradever's CEO on what actually matters in day trading. Spoiler: it's not your IQ. #tradever #propfirm #daytrading #futurestrading #ad @tradeverfunding @laythbanks

slides.text: You don't need a *high IQ* to trade.
slides.sub: Tradever's CEO says it comes down to something else.

slides.text: What really matters when it comes to day trading is not having a high IQ, it's about having a high EQ, which is emotional intelligence.
You could have the best strategy in the world, but if you are not disciplined and use proper risk management, nine times out of 10, you will find yourself failing.
